coverage.name: Hartman (town)
limitations: The Colorado Department of State determined on 2026-07-28 that the Town of Hartman has been abandoned under 31-3-201 C.R.S.; the town had no Board of Trustees or Town Clerk and could not hold an election.
not_applicable is based on the abandonment determination, not on a county participating-entities list (none is posted).
